name: Castro (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Castro is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 29 August 1979 (prescribed by Decree No. 57,179 of 29 August 1979, the arms by Municipal Law No. 2 of 5 April 1949, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown between branches, reading CASTRO
